newsitem.title: UK: British diplomat tried in Japanese porn case.
newsitem.headline: British diplomat tried in Japanese porn case.

text.p: A senior British diplomat stood trial on Tuesday on charges he smuggled a large collection of "depraved" child pornography from Japan.

Robert Coghlan, 54, who had spent 30 years in British embassies around the world, bought much of the material while first secretary in the information department at the embassy in Tokyo, prosecutors told a London court.

Videos, photographs and magazines considered obscene in Britain but not in Japan were found in Coghlan's belongings during a routine customs search before they were shipped out of Britain to his new posting in Spain.
Prosecutor Nigel Lithman told Southwark Crown Court that 70 videos were found containing scenes of homosexual "paedophilic depravity".
Coghlan denies the charges, which allege he tried to import indecent or obscene material knowing it was prohibited.
